title: Product resampling noise sensitivity
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\delta\in[0,1]$. For a function $f:\Omega^n\to\{\pm1\}$, its product resampling noise sensitivity is the probability, under the product retention pair distribution with retention parameter $1-\delta$, that the two sampled inputs receive different values under $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
